messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Alert (P1) — elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate in us-east-1 (hosted). 5xx rate ~15% over baseline, sustained 3m. Pager: oncall-anna.

oncall-anna: ack — I'm on it. @sre-marc joining for routing and scope.

sre-marc: joining — pulling cluster metrics. Nodepool infer-g4x shows high memory; several pods OOMKilled and restart-looping.

eng-runtime-leo: I see repeated segfaults in model-runner v2.3.4 on those pods. Snippet from journalctl: 
```
Nov 02 14:02:01 model-runner[2345]: terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
Nov 02 14:02:01 model-runner[2345]: Aborted (core dumped)
Nov 02 14:02:02 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (model-runner) score 987 or sacrifice child
```

eng-ml-kim: correlating with request patterns — long-context streams (>=8k tokens) causing kv-cache growth; mem climbs to ~98% before oom. Looks like a leak/unchecked growth on long queries.

oncall-anna: customer-impact: ~12% of hosted /v1/generate traffic gets 5xx/timeouts; some PLG customers reported failures. No signs of data exposure. Marking P1.

product-sam: should CS send a heads-up? need ETA before customer comms.

cs-julia: holding on comms; have a few enterprise tickets reporting degraded latency — not SLA-breaches yet but trending. Would like a mitigations ETA.

eng-runtime-leo: immediate mitigation plan: 1) reduce replicas for heavy model to limit simultaneous mem usage, 2) reroute new traffic to fallback smaller model 'redwood-base-quant' in us-east-1, 3) restart affected pods one-at-a-time after disabling prefetch to avoid warm-up mem spikes.

sre-marc: applying scaling changes now and preparing gateway reroute. Commands I'm running: 
```
kubectl scale deploy/model-runner-heavy --replicas=1 -n inference
kubectl set env deploy/model-runner-heavy PREFETCH=false -n inference
# gateway: switch route to fallback-model
redwood-gateway update-route --path /v1/generate --backend fallback-model --region us-east-1
```

eng-ml-kim: also lowering kv-cache TTL and enabling eviction thresholds so individual long requests can't grow unbounded.

oncall-anna: executing reroute at 14:05 UTC. Informing SRE to watch OOMs during restarts.

incident-bot: action logged: oncall-anna set routing policy -> fallback-model at 2024-11-02T14:05:12Z.

sre-marc: restarted pods sequentially; restarted instances come up clean, no OOM on restart. Cluster mem usage falling. 5xx rate dropping to ~3% after reroute.

eng-runtime-leo: rolling hotpatch v2.3.5 with KVCACHE hard cap and safer allocation path; rolling update started.

product-sam: what's ETA for roll-forward vs rollback?

eng-runtime-leo: rolling forward with patched binary; expected finish ~20m (rolling across 6 nodes). If rollback preferred, we can shift traffic back to older stable binary but that risks repeat OOM. Recommend roll-forward.

cs-julia: I'll update impacted customers: mitigation in place, routing to fallback, patch rolling; ETA ~20m.

oncall-anna: monitoring metrics (5xx, p95 latency, OOM events). If errors <1% for 30m we de-escalate.

eng-ml-kim: follow-ups to add to postmortem: KVCACHE memory ceiling, long-context canary traffic, alerts for kv growth, and safer prefetch defaults.

incident-bot: Incident P1 acknowledged and ticket created: PMT-3280004321.

oncall-anna: leaving the thread but on-call; ping here for critical regressions.

sre-marc: noting hosts that had repeated OOMs for deeper kernel-level analysis; capturing gcore and coredumps for postmortem.

eng-runtime-leo: capturing logs and correlating request ids for reproducer. Will attach in PM.

cs-julia: sending customer status update now — will escalate if any enterprise reports SLA impact.

oncall-anna: keeping watch. If we hit any new OOMs or segfaults revert traffic immediately.

incident-bot: current status: mitigation applied, reroute active, rolling patch in progress, 5xx reduced to ~2.7% (from 15%). Monitoring ongoing.
